# Best Shower Kit

> Best Shower Kit (bestshowerkit.com) sells walk-in shower kits, barrier-free and low-threshold shower pans, and shower wall panel systems, supply-only or installed. It is a brand of Aging Safely Baths, a BBB Accredited Business working on accessible bathrooms since 2012. Phone: 1-888-779-2284 (Monday to Friday). Free written quotes.

Key facts:
- 34 stock footprints across 77 size-and-style configurations; custom sizes and colors built to order.
- Shower pan thresholds from 0.5 in to 2 in, in quarter-inch steps.
- Aging Safely Baths sells and installs Bestbath (including RANE by Bestbath), Hydro Dimensions, Ella's Bubbles (authorized dealer) and Meditub; serves all 50 states; supply-only shipping to Canada.
- Kits ship as oversized freight, quoted by ZIP code.
- Product warranties are the manufacturer's written warranties; ask for the terms for a specific product before ordering.

## Buying guides
- [How to measure for a shower kit](https://bestshowerkit.com/how-to-measure-for-a-shower-kit/): worksheet for width, depth, square, drain, valve, ceiling and delivery path
- [Curbed vs curbless shower kits](https://bestshowerkit.com/curbed-vs-curbless-shower-kits/): choosing the threshold
- [Shower pan vs shower base](https://bestshowerkit.com/shower-pan-vs-shower-base/): molded base, tile-ready base and site-built pan explained
- [What is included in a shower kit](https://bestshowerkit.com/whats-included-in-a-shower-kit/): line-by-line checklist
- [DIY vs professional installation](https://bestshowerkit.com/diy-vs-pro-shower-kit-installation/): skills, permits, older-home hazards
- [Walk-in shower kit cost](https://bestshowerkit.com/walk-in-shower-cost/): component prices and published national ranges
- [Best shower kits 2026](https://bestshowerkit.com/best-shower-kits/): kit types compared
- [Shower kit materials](https://bestshowerkit.com/shower-kit-materials/): fiberglass, acrylic, solid surface, tile
- [Choosing a shower kit for a small bathroom](https://bestshowerkit.com/blog/shower-kit-small-bathroom/): smallest code-compliant sizes, depth vs width, doors vs curtains
- [Where to put grab bars in a walk-in shower](https://bestshowerkit.com/blog/grab-bar-placement-walk-in-shower/): 33-36 in height (ADA 609.4), layout by shower type, wall backing
- [Built-in or fold-down: choosing a shower seat](https://bestshowerkit.com/blog/built-in-vs-fold-down-shower-seat/): bench vs fold-down vs chair, 17-19 in seat height (ADA 610.3)
- [Putting a shower kit in a mobile or manufactured home](https://bestshowerkit.com/blog/shower-kit-mobile-manufactured-home/): sizes, drain access from below, leveling, narrow doors, permits
